description: Returns one Futuur event with all its markets: the full description and resolution criteria, dates, category, volumes and liquidity, and for each market its id, title, price (probability of the long position, per currency), status, resolution, depth and last trade time. Takes an EVENT id (the `id` of an item from get_markets); the market ids inside the result are what get_order_book and trading tools take. Use it before trading to read the resolution rules, or to check the current state of one event.

id.description: Event id, as returned by get_markets. Not a market id.

name: get_market_details
title: Get event details
